route.name: Offline Notion Alternatives
route.description: Personal offline notes and locally available organized content in installed native workspaces. Compare AFFiNE desktop documents and whiteboards, Anytype local objects, and AppFlowy native offline mode. Notion also supports prepared offline pages in desktop/mobile apps. Cloud sync, hosted imports, remote attachments and collaboration have separate requirements. This does not guarantee complete Notion parity or full cloud-content availability offline.
